name: AutoTrace
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Bitmap to SVG tracing, outline or centerline strokes
summary: CLI and library that converts bitmaps to vectors: filled colour outlines, or centerline tracing that turns stroke art into stroke-only SVG paths. Many output formats (SVG, EPS, PDF, DXF). Output is deterministic for fixed input and options.
use_when: Turning line drawings or handwriting into single stroked paths for vpype plotting or stroke-draw animation
Centerline tracing, which potrace and vtracer do not offer
avoid_when: One-bit outline tracing alone: potrace is simpler
Copyleft is a problem when bundling: GPL-2.0-or-later and LGPL-2.1-or-later
license: GPL-2.0-or-later and LGPL-2.1-or-later (Homebrew metadata); GitHub reports GPL-2.0
notes: 2026-11-27: lead said 0.31.12 with unverified date; GitHub and Homebrew show 0.31.13 released 2026-11-26.

assessment.rationale: Free software (copyleft), maintained again with a release a day before assessment. Adds centerline tracing missing from potrace and vtracer. Noisy scans untested.

evidence.result: Outline IoU 0.9941 (floor 0.97), centerline IoU 0.9023 (floor 0.90) after resvg rasterisation; 4 stroke-only paths, widths 7.89 to 8.79; repeat bytes equal; strokes SVG SHA-256 f006293966409c65367619839b3d7c94f16b2aa2e3d2fbadf44dd24e342f8e67
evidence.scope: Generated 200x200 shapes and 8px strokes, outline and centerline SVG, macOS arm64, 0.31.13; no scans, colour, noise, junction or cross-platform claim.
